rationale: Two same-day squash merges (#45, #49) landed while the ecosystem check was failing or pending; the audit that day concluded nothing in automation gates any merge on checks, and the post-merge remediate step added later mitigates but does not prevent recurrence on any lane that skips it.

lesson.title: Automated merges wait for required checks to finish green
lesson.source: cycle logs 2026-08-24-1112/1146 - PR #45 and #49 squash-merged ahead of check completion while main's ecosystem job was red 7+ runs
lesson.lesson: No automated merge path may execute until every required check on the target branch has completed green - poll check status and hold, or depend on branch protection that enforces it; never invoke a merge command that ignores check state. Merging on pending or failing checks lands broken commits on main and stamps provenance claiming health the fleet cannot honor (guarantee 5). A post-merge verify-and-remediate loop mitigates damage but does not license the merge.
